before.title: BLACKBOX · flight recorder for agent runs

after.title: BLACKBOX: replay a Pi agent run and find the fault
after.description: Upload a Pi --mode json log. BLACKBOX replays each step, uses the Clef model to score which step went wrong, and gives you a share URL.

e2e.narration: We are reviewing the marketing-pass-e2e recording. The scorer identified waypoint 2 as the point where the run encountered issues. At waypoint 2, the assistant recognized that placeholders in the prompt were unresolved and attempted to create a script to determine the actual files. The assistant's approach involved incrementing issue numbers until one failed. This decision led to the subsequent tool call at waypoint 4, which resulted in an error at waypoint 3. The error was later resolved at waypoint 5, allowing the assistant to successfully load and classify issues at waypoint 6.
